module: Small utility module (loaded by require) of performance telemetry: safe reading of VariableRegistry variables, the program's focus state and the cause of an FPS cap chosen by the player.

readNumber.desc: Reads a VariableRegistry variable as a number; returns -1 if it is absent, non-numeric, NaN or infinite.

readAvailable.desc: Like readNumber but returns nil instead of -1 (value unavailable).

isFocused.desc: Indicates whether the game window has focus (true if Engine.isProgramFocused does not exist).

returns.desc: true if the program has focus.

getLimitedBy.desc: Says which player-chosen FPS cap applies: 'background' (limit in the background without focus), 'vr' (OpenXR session), 'limiter' (fpsLimitEnabled), 'vsync', otherwise nil. Used to avoid mistaking an FPS locked at 60 for a machine unable to do better.
